name: covid-walks-past-the-army
why: Opens on COVID out-killing six wars, and the germ strolls past a factory that blows itself up looking for it, takes the globe, and bites YOU.

name: bombers-into-cadillacs
why: Opens on the 87.6% cut in two years, turns a B-24 into a Cadillac and raises the city of tomorrow, then YOU panics over 1% and Wishonia's 'It's the second one' lands the joke.

name: pharma-casino
why: Opens on $2.6 billion a pull at a slot machine that pays out a skull nine times in ten, turns the casino into a paycheck, and pays off with the stampede to sign and 'Change the math.'
